entities.summary: Robert Fabbri is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Minnesota Wild of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted in the first round, 21st overall, by the St. Louis Blues in the 2014 NHL entry draft, and has also played for the Detroit Red Wings and Anaheim Ducks
